0.title: Redis operations per minute
0.query:
fetch spans
| filter db.system == "redis"
| makeTimeseries ops = count(), by:{span.name}, interval:1m

1.title: Cache hit ratio (%)
1.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(cache.hit)
| makeTimeseries hit_pct = countIf(cache.hit == true) * 100.0 / count(), interval:1m

2.title: Postgres queries per minute
2.query:
fetch spans
| filter db.system == "postgresql"
| makeTimeseries queries = count(), interval:1m

3.title: DB latency p95 by system
3.query:
fetch spans
| filter isNotNull(db.system)
| makeTimeseries p95 = percentile(duration, 95), by:{db.system}, interval:1m

4.title: Top statements by mean duration
4.query:
fetch spans
| filter db.system == "postgresql" and isNotNull(db.statement)
| summarize mean_duration = avg(duration), calls = count(), by:{db.statement}
| sort mean_duration desc
| limit 10

5.content:
## Scope note

Mirrors *Tasklog - Data stores* in Grafana. Connection-pool utilisation and transactions/sec come from postgres-exporter, a Prometheus citizen - Grafana keeps those. Dynatrace sees the **query-level truth instead: every statement as a span**, which is what the p95 and top-statements tiles are built from.
